verdict.rationale: Oneleet's MDM lets admins take remote action on devices being offboarded. Its integrations monitor user accounts and access in Google Workspace, AWS IAM and GitHub, which could help show that leavers lost access. Nothing in the pack describes HR-system sync, onboarding/offboarding checklists, or security-training completion tracking. Missing for 10: HR integration/sync, structured onboarding and offboarding checklists, training completion evidence for new hires, documented automated access-revocation verification, independent corroboration.
